explication: Apereo CAS is a web identity provider and single-sign-on server. Its principal user flow is a browser login handled by the central authentication service, which authenticates a user and enables access through supported identity protocols. The repository also documents delegated identity, multifactor authentication, authorization, application registration, consent, and operational auditing. The tree and sampled sources show central-service, authentication, service-access, surrogate, and trusted-device responsibilities; many protocol and integration implementations are unsampled, so those capability links reflect README documentation rather than inspected call paths.
